findings.summary: Added probe_with_bin closure that tries d directly then d/bin/; both the current_exe branch and the resource_dir fallback now call it via .and_then(probe_with_bin) so the shim at resource_dir/bin/codemie.cmd is found.
findings.test: probe_dir_detects_shim_in_bin_subdir_and_not_parent — verifies that probe_dir on the bin/ subdir returns true and on the parent returns false, confirming the subdirectory layout.

findings.summary: Added #[cfg(windows)] persist(&[dir_str.to_string()]) call after the set_var call inside inject_bundled_bin_path. Errors from persist are surfaced via log::warn! rather than silently dropped.
findings.test: cargo test --lib 31/31 passing; persist is the existing Windows-only function that writes HKCU\Environment and broadcasts WM_SETTINGCHANGE.

findings.summary: Replaced the tautological probe_detects_codemie_cmd_shim test (which only asserted file.exists() and a static slice) with three tests that directly call the new probe_dir() pub function: probe_dir_detects_codemie_cmd_shim, probe_dir_returns_false_for_empty_directory, probe_dir_detects_shim_in_bin_subdir_and_not_parent.
findings.test: All three new tests in tests_windows_probe pass: 3/3 ok.

findings.summary: Updated line 3 comment from 'Windows: commands run via powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command' to 'Windows: commands run via cmd.exe /c'.

Extracted the direct-invocation branch of run_self_update into a new pub(crate) async fn self_update_direct(node_exe, cli_entry) and refactored run_self_update to call it. Added test self_update_direct_errors_when_node_not_executable in tests_windows_self_update that writes a non-PE file as the fake node.exe and asserts Err is returned. Documents that the exit-0 success path requires a real node.exe and is deferred to stage-7 integration testing.

Added two log::warn! calls inside the #[cfg(windows)] block of run_self_update that execute when the direct-invocation guard fails. Each call reports the specific missing path (node_exe_path or cli_entry_path) before falling back to capture('codemie self-update', None).
findings.test: cargo test --lib 31/31 passing; log::warn! calls compile correctly.

findings.summary: Expanded the SAFETY comment on the set_var call in inject_bundled_bin_path to state the Tauri 2.x threading guarantee: setup() executes synchronously before any plugin::init() spawns a worker thread; Builder::run() wraps event-loop initialisation rather than setup(). Adds guidance to move the call if Tauri's threading model changes.

Replaced eprintln!("{e}") with log::error!("{e}") in the inject_bundled_bin_path error handler inside setup(). Added an inline comment explaining that eprintln! is swallowed in a packaged GUI and that log::error! is captured by the log plugin (debug builds) and any custom subscriber.
findings.test: cargo clippy --lib -- -D warnings: clean; cargo test --lib 31/31 passing.

findings.summary: Decision: defer node/ and cli/ bundle.resources entries to EPMCDME-14505. Declaring them now without the source files would break tauri build. Added NOTE(EPMCDME-14573 CR-009) comment in lib.rs setup() explaining that until EPMCDME-14505 delivers the files, node_exe_path and cli_entry_path resolve to empty PathBufs and run_self_update falls back to the codemie.cmd shim on PATH.
findings.test: n/a — documentation-only change; the resource entry for bin/codemie.cmd already declared in tauri.conf.json is unmodified.
